screening_answers.question: Why do you want this Python/AI Developer role at Honeybee Tech Solutions?
screening_answers.answer: The role is backend Python with REST APIs and databases, plus GenAI and agent work on the side. That is what I have been building: FastAPI services, SQL databases and LLM agents. It is also on-site in Pune, where I live. I know little about Honeybee beyond the posting, so I would like to learn what you build and where the AI work fits.

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience with Python and Python web frameworks (Django, Flask, FastAPI).
screening_answers.answer: I use Python and FastAPI. nanoserve is an LLM inference engine I built from scratch in Python, PyTorch and FastAPI, with an OpenAI-compatible streaming API and 3.1x throughput over sequential decoding in benchmarks. lead-intel-engine is a FastAPI and SQLite service with a rate-limited crawler and scoring. I have not used Django or Flask in production. FastAPI covers the same ground for REST work, and I would pick up either quickly.

screening_answers.question: What is your experience with REST API development and databases (SQL/NoSQL)?
screening_answers.answer: I have built REST APIs with FastAPI and Node, including HMAC-signed webhooks and Stripe, Twilio and HubSpot integrations. On the database side I work with PostgreSQL (Neon, Supabase with row-level security), SQLite and pgvector. In Orbital Surplus, stock holds run in one transaction so only one shopper gets the last unit, and 9 end-to-end API tests cover it. My databases so far are relational; I have not worked with NoSQL in a project.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience with GenAI, LLM integration, AI agents and agentic workflows? Have you used LangChain or LlamaIndex?
screening_answers.answer: Yes. At the US-based medical-device company I built internal AI agents. In my own projects, multi-agent-research-crew runs planner, researcher, writer and verifier agents on a custom asyncio DAG with retries, token budgets and claim-level citation checks. site-to-agent grounds chat answers in a website using hybrid BM25 and vector retrieval, with cited answers and an eval harness. I use the Claude and Gemini APIs and hold Claude Certified Developer and Google Cloud Generative AI Leader certificates. I wrote my own orchestration and retrieval rather than using LangChain or LlamaIndex, so I have not used those two, but I would use them where they fit.

screening_answers.question: Tell us about a project you are proud of.
screening_answers.answer: nanoserve. I wanted to understand how LLM serving works, so I built an inference engine from scratch: paged KV cache, prefix caching, continuous batching with preemption and speculative decoding, behind a FastAPI streaming API. In benchmarks it reached 3.1x the throughput of sequential decoding. I benchmarked first and optimised after. Code: github.com/huss2003/nanoserve

screening_answers.question: What are your salary expectations?
screening_answers.answer: I am looking for INR 30,000 or more per month. I am flexible on structure; the work and the total package matter to me.

screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in September 2026.

screening_answers.question: Are you comfortable working on-site in Pune? Where are you based?
screening_answers.answer: Yes. I am based in Pune and happy to work on-site.
